profile.headline: Software Engineer @ American Express
profile.summary:
Software Engineer with 13 years of experience. I have worked on a wide range of projects, from small-scale applications to large-scale enterprise systems. Throughout my career, I have gained expertise working with Microsoft Framework Development .NET, I am also proficient in databases, Web and Cloud development.
I'm passionate to deliver high-quality software that add value to the business.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description: As a Software Developer, I was part of a cross-functional team in an agile environment, in charge of reviewing and analyzing user requirements to finally develop the features that will be included in the next releases. On my daily basis I met the client team, including product owner, QA and Software Engineers to discuss the project progress and address any concerns.

positions.title: Senior Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
I was in charge of developing and maintaining some banking applications (Online Banking, Mobile App and ATM Services). I'd work with external providers to expand our payment services across Central America, providing our clients new and modern financial services in different digital channels. I'd also work with different product owners to define a clear roadmap and backlog for different financial products.
Achievements:
Development of a regional remittance systems for LAFISE Group in collaboration with BBVA Bank.
Development of Instantaneous Operations Payment for Dominican Republic LAFISE bank via MT 103 messages with collaboration of SWIFT.org.
Development and migration of the automated clearing house (ACH) system using the ISO20022 standard for Panama LAFISE Bank.

positions.title: Junior Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
Responsibilities:
Developed new features to banking applications for different digital channels (Online Banking, Mobile Banking, ATM Services).
Worked closely with internal clients to establish specifications and system designs.
Trained final users with the software application delivered.
Achievements:
Improvement in internal process for Wire Transfers in Central America via online banking.
Development of an online system of quotes for personal loans.

positions.title: Analyst Developer
positions.description:
Responsibilities:
Met with clients and raise requirements for new developments and/ or improvements.
Participated in cross-functional projects while working in agile development environments.
Developing applications that meet user requirements and needs.
Achievements:
Development of an Online System for Insurance Policy Quotes for one of the main insurance companies in Nicaragua (Seguros America, S.A.).

positions.title: Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
Responsibilities:
Develop new functionalities to the main product of the company (SIS.NET).
Provide innovative ideas that will improve the application process.
Train Insurers workers with latest features.
Adapt the SIS.NET to each insurer according to the national insurance criteria for Insurance companies across Central America.
